QueryReference.name: Query Reference
QueryReference.definition: Identification of the SecuritiesStatementQuery message sent to request this statement.

ReportDateTime.name: Report Date Time
ReportDateTime.definition: Date and time of the report.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Preparation date and time of the report.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of the report.

UpdateType.name: Update Type
UpdateType.definition: Specifies whether the report is complete or contains changes only.

ReportBasis.name: Report Basis
ReportBasis.definition: Specifies the type of balance on which the report is prepared.

ReportPeriod.name: Report Period
ReportPeriod.definition: Period for which the report is given.

ReportSource.name: Report Source
ReportSource.definition: Specifies the source of the report.

AuditedIndicator.name: Audited Indicator
AuditedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the report is audited or not.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity or an information update reported in the report.
